modelspec.training.LearningRateSchedule.title: LearningRateSchedule
modelspec.training.LearningRateSchedule.description: How the learning rate varies over steps, settled by coordinator decision D50 of 2026-10-25 under the operator's grant of 2026-10-24, after Devlin et al. 2019. With t counting steps from 1 and steps the run's total, the rate is lr*t/warmup_steps for t <= warmup_steps and lr*(steps-t)/(steps-warmup_steps) after, lr being OptimizerConfig.learning_rate; it starts above zero, peaks at lr at step warmup_steps and reaches zero at the last step. warmup_steps = 0 means no warmup; warmup_steps >= steps is refused (E-TYPE-024, or a run error when --steps shortens the run). The host computes each step's rate in Binary64 and rounds it once to Binary32 (DESIGN.md § 2.1, § 6).
